reference.title: Tag and image management
reference.shortdesc: The following configuration fields control how tags and images are managed within Red Hat Quay. These settings help track image activity, automate image cleanup, and enforce tag policies.

section.p: You can use these fields to:

ul.li: Track image pull activity and display statistics in the web UI.
Define expiration policies for untagged or outdated images.
Enable immutable tag policies to prevent tag overwrites.

section.p: These options help maintain an up-to-date image registry environment.
